item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
Annotate 1.9.0

Annotate 1.9.0

此 Release 由 GitHub Actions 自动构建。

更新内容

  • docs: README 按本仓库的发布方式重新梳理
  • ci: Release tag 改为不带 v 前缀的版本号
  • ci: 自动构建 ad-hoc 签名版本并发布 Release，新增一键安装脚本
  • chore: 项目归属迁移到 sunimp
  • chore: 版本号升至 1.9.0
  • fix: 允许 DMG 签名失败后继续完成打包
  • test: Xcode 测试固定使用英文，避免读到系统语言
  • feat: 多屏标注范围、拖动与 fade 性能优化、指针回到叠加层时恢复键盘焦点
  • chore: 测试切到 Swift 6，精简 SwiftLint 基线
  • docs: 添加 CLAUDE.md
  • feat(settings): 固定线宽、固定颜色改为连续可调；文本工具图标改为 T
  • feat(settings): 默认线宽、默认颜色支持固定值
  • docs(agents): SwiftUI 传 String 时改用 L10n.string
  • feat(l10n): 设置页加语言选择，运行时切换，默认跟随系统
  • docs: 记录本地化流程与规则表 E
  • feat(l10n): 支持简繁中文、日文、西班牙文、法文
  • docs(agents): 规则表 A 更新为 redraw ratchet 已落地的现状
  • fix(undo): 移动撤销按位置找回对象，替换 Any 存储
  • feat(capture): Add Capture Area (#143)
  • feat(capture): Add Capture Screen (#142)
  • refactor(overlay): Extract AnnotationRenderer from OverlayView (#141)
  • fix(undo): Undo a Clear All of every display in one step (#140)
  • fix(url): Hand focus back when a second link beats the launch activation (#139)
  • feat(toolbar): Add VoiceOver labels to toolbar buttons (#138)
  • fix(url): Hand focus back after links and keep rejected links out of the log (#137)
  • feat(url): Add annotate:// links that run commands (#136)
  • feat(commands): Add a shared command layer and Shortcuts actions (#135)
  • chore: Update appcast.xml and version for release v1.8.0
  • fix(toolbar): Even out vertical section widths (#133)
  • fix(toolbar): Let a drag that starts on a chip move the bar (#132)

See the full changelog for details.
